items.title: Michael Moore interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: I mean people like Gil Evans came up to me and he said, “Have you got any more songs like ‘Wisdom of the Heart?’”

ctx.x: I’ll try to find it for you. In fact, I think they mentioned your tune here. “The Old New Waltz.” Tell me how that tune came about.

Well I left the country at one point. I actually moved to India in ‘89. I quit playing the bass, and went to India, and ended up in London. It didn’t work out in India, and I ended up in London and was playing piano, but mostly not doing much of anything. And then I started playing bass again over there. But I was spending a lot of time on piano, and I occasionally was coming back to New York. And I spent a lot of time writing around that time, and I didn’t think much of that tune.
